description_en: Add tags to Anti-DDoS Origin instances
description_zh: 为指定资源（DDoS原生防护实例）绑定标签
kebab_example: aliyun ddosbgp tag-resources --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type INSTANCE --resource-id ddosbgp-cn-n6w1r7nz0000 --tag Value=test-value Key=test-key --api-version 2018-07-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: TagResources

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not specify this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group.
parameters.description_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组。
